pr_title: Fix process mode update when mode owner is set to Inherit
pr_body:
~When the process mode owner is the root and is set to `PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT`, the mode needs to be considered as the default (`PROCESS_MODE_PAUSABLE`) instead of making the node disabled.~

Fixes #49818

**Edit: refactored based on https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/49819#issuecomment-912971626**

Prevent the root node to be set to `PROCESS_MODE_INHERIT`, since it causes undefined behavior.

Fix a case where the process owner node is wrongly set to the directparent instead of the proper node.

Add errors for all unhandled cases.
pr_comments: I was checking this again, and I think mode owner should never be possibly set to inherit, I wonder if this is a bug somewhere else.

Ah right, the root node. I think for simplicity it should be set to PAUSABLE by default, and if changing the mode to INHERIT should error if `is_inside_tree() && get_tree()->get_root() == this`. We could probably do a consistency check with `unlikely()` and throw an error in the `can_process` function if the owner is set to inherit, as this would be a bug.
@reduz I've rebased and updated from your comment.

issue_context.title: Setting node `process_mode` to `Disabled` then back to `Inherit` doesn't reset the mode properly
issue_context.body: ### Godot version 3.3.2.stable, 4.0.dev (92f20fd70e6957cd65ccb7837fdc28f9b1e4a315) ### System information Windows 10 ### Issue description When changing the `process_mode` property on a node that is at least 2 levels deep in the tree (both parents are set to `Inherited`), setting the mode back to `Inherited` doesn't reset the current state properly. Example in the editor: the node stays grayed out even after setting it back to `Inherited`. Its state is reset properly only after setting the parent node to any mode then back to `Inherited`: ### Steps to reproduce Using the minimal reproduction project: 1. Open project in editor 2. Select `Node3` in the scene tree 3. Set `process_mode` to `Disabled` 4. Observe the node is grayed out (correct) 5. Set `process_mode` back to `Inherited` 6. Observe the node is still grayed out (incorrect) ### Minimal reproduction project [disable-node-bug-4.0.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/6690185/disable-node-bug-4.0.zip)

review_comments: This was causing a bug when switching back to inherit for a node with at least depth 2 in the tree, it was always using the direct parent as process owner instead of the correct node.
